description: Read Arx site security: status colour, hardening measures, known vulnerabilities, installed components, firewall blocks (wafBlocks lists at most 100; wafBlockTotal is the real count), administrator activity (adminEvents: created, promoted, signed in, frozen; with channel, address and the files that did it) and frozen accounts (frozenAdmins), and running changes. eventId (from adminEvents) returns that one event with the web server log lines of its address, for forensics.

eventId.description: Optional: id from adminEvents; returns that one event with the web server log lines of its address (forensics).

name: oma_arx_security_status
title: Arx site security
